description:
Cast Goldvein Hydra by paying {G}.
Goldvein Hydra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Pitiless Plunderer and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Goldvein Hydra from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
